title: hedyotis pinifolia var. horridula
intro: Hedyotis pinifolia var. horridula, commonly known as Mountain Gold or Chinese Goldenseal, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, boost immune systems, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis pinifolia var. horridula include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
